subject.title: feat(onboard): recommendations store with once-semantics and self-naming bootstrap

question: Should the first-run bootstrap defer profile-file and UI identity persistence until after the recommendation choice is acknowledged, preserving the complete three-beat ceremony in one durable flow?
rationale: The proposed order materially changes when workspace setup is considered complete, so maintainers must choose between preserving the planned recommendation handoff and intentionally accepting early bootstrap completion.

options.title: Defer identity persistence
options.body: Write `IDENTITY.md`/`SOUL.md` and run `agents set-identity` only after recommendation handling and acknowledgement, then add a regression test for the intervening user turn.

options.title: Accept early completion semantics
options.body: Keep identity persistence before the recommendation question and explicitly redesign the remaining recommendation flow so it survives bootstrap removal without relying on `BOOTSTRAP.md`.

recommendation.title: Defer identity persistence
recommendation.body: Write `IDENTITY.md`/`SOUL.md` and run `agents set-identity` only after recommendation handling and acknowledgement, then add a regression test for the intervening user turn.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR and its linked onboarding redesign plan define the affected first-run UX and persistence contract.
